item.tib: dbal phur 'bar ba nag po'i 'phrin las me ri 'khyil ba rin chen gter mdzod rgyud las khrom gtad me dpung 'bar ba'i gter ngar
item.coloph: dbal bon stag la me 'bar gyi thugs bcud/ khod spungs rig 'dzin chen po'i mdzad srol/ mkha' 'gro 'od ldan 'bar ba'i lung don/ mchog gi skyes bu chen po g.yung drung dbang rgyal gyis zhabs brdul (rdul) spyi bor blangs nas sa rta zla ba'i tshes la kong yul dga' ba'i tshal du dge//
